name: Paulus Simangungsong
bio: Paulus Simangunsong is an Indonesian stage and screen actor, theater director, playwright, and film acting coach. He is best known for his longtime work with Jakarta's renowned Teater Koma as well as his roles in major Batak-themed films and television series.

credits.title: Coming Home
credits.overview: A prominent young professional residing in Jakarta is abruptly recalled to his ancestral North Sumatra homeland by his patriarch to campaign for public office, where his political ambitions intersect with a transformative romantic awakening centered on the Batak customs he long neglected.

credits.title: Missing Home
credits.overview: A married couple stages their divorce in order to encourage their estranged adult children to return to their hometown.
